verdict_scope: Clear for the reviewed packaging delta only. This does not accept the whole release or certify CI.

scope.base: HEAD plus requested uncommitted packaging delta
scope.includes: release-candidate, release-matrix, packed-matrix, package-build, standards identity change, related tests, package.json, CI, README, manifest, export, lock inventory and notices
scope.excludes: Application behavior, database prerequisites, Wayfinder UUID diagnosis, application fixtures, global setup, lifecycle and publication

intent: Verify that U14 prepares and packages the pinned standards export with complete templates and compatible locks, verifies export bytes before executing its runtime, and retains identifiable packed evidence.

requirements_completeness.result: Implementation present for immutable export consumption, inventory, lock catalog, packed generation and CI gates. Whole U14 completion remains coordinator-owned.

residual_risks: The supplied standards digest is a trust input. Matching hashes prove integrity against that pin, not authenticity of a caller-selected export. Source comments and provenance explicitly leave tag/commit validation with the coordinator.

Release preparation uses a new external output directory for each run. It does not resume a failed directory. Complete preparation with network-dependent lock resolution was inspected but not rerun here.
CI checks out and repacks the same source in separate jobs. This review proves the supplied local archive matches the current source, not that Blacksmith has executed or published that archive.

License entitlement, live browser acceptance and application/database diagnoses remain outside this review. Notices and dependency-tree exclusion are packaging evidence, not a legal entitlement finding.
testing_gaps: Three optional standards source integration tests skipped because F7T_STANDARDS_FIXTURE_SOURCE was not supplied.
The 194-output, 66-frozen-key matrix was inspected through its existing receipt, not executed again. The caller's 401-pass, 7-skip whole suite was not rerun.
Review-local test runtime was Node 26.8.1 and Bun 1.4.2. The caller reports Node 22.23.2 and Bun 1.4.0 for the existing matrix; this review did not independently rerun that runtime combination.

coverage.mode: agent report-only, inline lenses as explicitly requested
coverage.cross_model: Not run, explicitly excluded by caller. No peer corroboration claimed.
coverage.validator: No retained findings required validation. No independent validator ran or shortcut was claimed.
verified: bun run verify:release passed and reported 962 package files with the complete release bundle.
Targeted Vitest run passed 42 tests across release-candidate, release-matrix, package, standards and README; 3 optional standards integration tests skipped.
Independently hashed the supplied tgz and compared every one of its 962 regular file payloads against the current checkout. No byte drift.
Existing matrix.json binds the same archive SHA-256 and records 194 receipts, 66 installed keys, 66 unique receipt keys, and omitted-asset, standards-digest and incompatible-lock negatives.

verifyStandardsBundle validates the supplied digest, runtime and asset bytes before prepareBundle imports apply.mjs. applyBundledStandards also verifies before import. Tampered-runtime and no-target-write tests passed.
Catalog completeness derives from the shared stack registry. Template version must equal generator version when a full commit is not supplied. Both paths have passing rejection tests.

Preparation and matrix commands reject an existing output directory. Composer locks are validated and copied; frozen matrix installs compare lock bytes afterward. Package audits reject omitted assets and dependency/runtime payloads.
